title: Synth writer capability runtime production authorization v1
description: Versioned schema for the deployment production authorization file consumed by the shared writer-capability authorization library. A schema-invalid authorization always fails closed and never grants production ownership.

commit_verification_mode.description: EXACT (default when absent) requires HEAD to equal authorized_commit exactly, unchanged legacy semantics. ANCESTOR requires authorized_commit to be an ancestor of (or equal to) HEAD and requires required_branch to also be satisfied, so one stable authorization file survives normal approved fast-forward deploys without a per-commit edit.

required_branch.description: Required only when commit_verification_mode is ANCESTOR. The only permitted value is the literal branch name 'main' -- never a wildcard or arbitrary branch -- and HEAD must resolve to exactly this branch, not be detached.
